latest_release.name: v4.4.0 — Antigravity 1.4 Parity, Faster Gentle Shell Launches and Safer Windows Restores
latest_release.body:
Gentle AI v4.4.0 is a minor release over v4.3.1. Restores and rollbacks now work when Windows redirects `%APPDATA%` outside the profile, and a workspace uninstall snapshot can be restored on its own. JSON and JSONC configs that start with a UTF-8 BOM keep the user's keys instead of being merged into an empty object. The Windows Full Suite is green again and now runs on every pull request. Antigravity (agy 1.4) reaches parity with native Judgment Day agents, per-role model tiers and guidance that fits agy's 24 KB rule budget. Gentle Shell provisions Stable from a reviewed gentle-pi supplier list, launches in a fraction of the time, and publishes `gs` on Windows. Codex honors `CODEX_HOME` end to end. The provider contract stays byte-frozen at `1.4.0`.

## Provenance

- **Previous stable:** `v4.3.1` → `2dba7784114fff57864519c4c0d067e952a8c98b`
- **Release target:** `v4.4.0` → `55240afb100ad6d2ef5fbe16f7be33a7693f77ad`
- **Release workflow:** [run 42396346091](https://github.com/Gentleman-Programming/gentle-ai/actions/runs/42396346091)
- **Verification:** preflight, release, and verify jobs all succeeded.
- **Provider contract:** `1.4.0`

## What's new

### Antigravity 1.4 parity

Antigravity now receives the Judgment Day native agents (`jd-judge-a`, `jd-judge-b`, `jd-fix-agent`) that Claude Code, Cursor and Kiro already had. Their model tier (`inherit`, `flash_lite`, `flash`, `pro`) can be picked per role in the installer and changed later from Configure Models. Gentle AI guidance is rendered as owned agy rule files that each stay under agy's 24 KB limit, and legacy Gentle AI sections in `GEMINI.md` are migrated into them.

Included work: [#5931](https://github.com/Gentleman-Programming/gentle-ai/pull/5931), [#5938](https://github.com/Gentleman-Programming/gentle-ai/pull/5938), [#5939](https://github.com/Gentleman-Programming/gentle-ai/pull/5939), [#5940](https://github.com/Gentleman-Programming/gentle-ai/pull/5940), [#5941](https://github.com/Gentleman-Programming/gentle-ai/pull/5941), [#5942](https://github.com/Gentleman-Programming/gentle-ai/pull/5942) (issue #5930).

### Gentle Shell Stable follows a reviewed gentle-pi supplier list

Gentle Shell now ships a reviewed list of gentle-pi releases, each pinned by its npm tarball SRI and installer hash, and reads it live with a fail-safe fallback. Stable installs provision the newest reviewed release, the Windows provisioner reads the same list, installs without a list authenticate supplier files at launch, and the Stable update check detects an outdated gentle-pi by its installed version and targets the newest listed release. gentle-pi 4.5.1 is the first reviewed entry.

Included work: [#5849](https://github.com/Gentleman-Programming/gentle-ai/pull/5849), [#5852](https://github.com/Gentleman-Programming/gentle-ai/pull/5852), [#5853](https://github.com/Gentleman-Programming/gentle-ai/pull/5853), [#5863](https://github.com/Gentleman-Programming/gentle-ai/pull/5863), [#5871](https://github.com/Gentleman-Programming/gentle-ai/pull/5871), [#5873](https://github.com/Gentleman-Programming/gentle-ai/pull/5873), [#5876](https://github.com/Gentleman-Programming/gentle-ai/pull/5876) (issue #5845) by @decode2.

### Faster Gentle Shell launches

Standalone `gentle-shell`/`gs` launches spent 13 to 19 seconds re-verifying unchanged bytes on every start. Pinned binaries, the retained Main source and the installed graph are now checked against ctime-bound stamp caches and receipts that a prior full audit produced, so every check stays as strict while unchanged bytes are no longer re-read. Main launches drop to about 3.3 seconds and Stable launches from 2.81 to 0.33 seconds; a timing probe on the Windows runtime lane measured the Windows launch boundary at about 52 ms warm.
